# Irrigation schedule

Zones one through six run for twelve minutes at dawn. Zone seven runs for
eight minutes because its drip line pressure is lower.

## Valve chatter

Zone seven valve chatter comes from a worn solenoid spring. Replace the
spring; do not raise the line pressure, that only masks it for a week.
